contexts.text: When the elders of Israel represented celestial men, they were called wise, etc.
In the other life, the interiors shine forth from the face; the exteriors are represented in both their bodies and clothing... So with the twenty-four elders around the throne.
The elder servant of Abraham's house () = the Natural, or the natural man... That the elder of the house = the natural man, may be evident from what follows. AC 3209:end.
As by the twenty-four thrones, and the twenty-four elders are signified all things of truth, or all things of faith in one complex...
Not that they, or any elders of them, will judge, but that the truths themselves will do so which are signified by them... AC 6397:3.

The elders of Pharaoh's house () = which agree with good. Elders = the chief things of wisdom, thus agreement with good... The reason elders = the chief things of wisdom, is that in the Word old men = the wise, and, in a sense abstracted from person, wisdom. As the twelve tribes of Israel = all truths and goods in the complex, there were princes set over them, and also elders; and by the princes were signified primary truths, which are of intelligence; and by the elders, the chief things of wisdom, thus those which are of good. Illustrated.
The assembly of the elders () = those who are in good, which is of wisdom.
The elders (in ) = those things which are of wisdom, thus which are of good. That the elders = these things, is evident from the description... AC 6524:4.
In order that the elders might represent those things which are of wisdom, there was taken of the spirit of Moses and given to them, from which they prophesied. ().
In the opposite sense, elders = those things which are contrary to wisdom. ().
And all the elders of the land of Egypt () = which agree with truth. Explained.
Go, and gather together the elders of Israel () = the intelligent in the Spiritual Church... Elders = the chief things of Wisdom and intelligence, thus the intelligent.
They gathered together all the elders of the Sons of Israel () = the chief things of wisdom which appertain to the Spiritual Church.

Moses called all the elders of Israel () = the enlightenment of the understanding of those who are of the Spiritual Church by means of the influx and presence of truth Divine... Elders = the chief things of wisdom and intelligence which agree with truth and good; to call which is to enlighten the understanding.

Take with thee of the elders of Israel () = from primary truths. The elders of Israel = the primary things of wisdom and intelligence which agree with good and with truth; thus primary truths; for these are of intelligence and wisdom. AC 8585.
Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel () = the things which are primary of the Church... The elders of Israel = the chief truths of the Church which agree with good.

Moses came and called the elders of the people () = the choice of those who primarily are in the intelligence of truth... The elders of the people = those who are primarily in the intelligence of truth; and, in a sense abstracted from person, primary truths.
The elders of the city () = truths that agree with good.
The elders with whom Jehovah will enter into judgment () = the goods of the Church.
And seventy of the elders of Israel () = the chief truths of the Church or of doctrine which agree with good.

And seventy of the elders of Israel () = all who are in good from truths... The elders of Israel = those who are in good from truths, and in truths from good; for by old men in the Word are signified those who are in wisdom, thus who are in the life of good from the doctrine of truth.

He said to the elders () = those who are solely in the external sense... The reason the elders of the Israelitish people here represent these, is that they were the heads of the people, and thus represented the whole people.
The twenty-four elders = all those who are in good from truths; and, in the abstract sense, all goods from truths.
His being taken and condemned by the chiefs of the priests and by the elders, signified that this was done by that entire Church.
Upon the thrones I saw twenty-four elders sitting () = the ordination of all things in Heaven for the Last Judgment.

The twelve tribes of Israel and their elders = all who are of the Lord's Church... and, abstractedly, all truths and goods therein... The twelve apostles and the twenty-four elders = all things of the Church... Hence it is evident why thrones and elders are mentioned when judgment is treated of. Illustrated.

The twenty-four elders fell down before Him that sat upon the throne, and worshipped Him that liveth for ever and ever () = the humiliation of all in Heaven before the Lord. By the twenty-four elders are meant all who are of the Lord's Church; here, all who are of His Church in Heaven. The elders, as the heads, represented all.
In the midst of the elders () = from inmost things, and consequently in all things of the Church... The twenty-four elders = the Church as to all things of it.

The four animals and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb () = humiliation, and from humiliation the adoration of the Lord from the higher Heavens... The higher Heavens are therefore signified by the four animals and the twenty-four elders.... By the twenty-four elders are also signified the Angels in the higher Heavens, because these elders were the nearest round the throne. AR 369. AR 808. AE 322.

The twenty-four elders, who sat before God upon their thrones, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God () = the acknowledgement by all the Angels of Heaven that the Lord is the God of Heaven and earth, and the highest adoration. By the twenty-four elders sitting upon the thrones are signified all in Heaven; in special, in the Spiritual Heaven.

They sung as it were a new song before... the four animals and before the elders () = celebration and glorification of the Lord before... the Angels of the higher Heavens... The former Heavens are from the ancients and the most ancients; and the Lord is acknowledged in these Heavens as the God of Heaven and earth.
The elders () = the intelligent.

Upon the thrones I saw twenty-four elders sitting all truths from good in the higher Heavens ordered by the Lord before the Judgment... The twenty-four elders upon the thrones = all the truths of Heaven in the complex ordered before the Judgment... The elders = those who are in truths from good; and, abstractedly, truths from good. The reason the higher Heavens are here meant, is that all there are in truths from the good of love; and also because the lower Heavens are spoken of in the words which immediately follow.
That elders = truths from good. Illustrated.
The twenty-four elders fell down before Him that sat upon the throne = humiliation, and at the same time acknowledgement by those who are in truths from good. AE 349.
The twenty-four elders = all who are in truth from good both in the Heavens and on earth.
One of the elders () = a Society of Heaven which surpassed the rest in wisdom. Elders = those who are in truths from good... thus those who surpass all others in intelligence and wisdom...

The elders () = those who are in truths from good; here, therefore, those who are in the Second Heaven. Explained... In general, by the four animals is signified all the Divine good in the universal Heaven which guards; and by the elders, all the Divine truth proceeding from the Divine good also in the universal Heaven; and both guard, because they are united. Thus by the four animals and the elders, taken together, is signified the Divine good united to the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord, and, from this, the whole angelic Heaven; but, specially, the two inmost Heavens. AE 324:end. AE 1206.
The elders have ceased from the gate () = that those who are in truths from good, or, abstractedly, the truths from good by which there is admission into the Church, have no existence.
Elders () = those who are in intelligence and wisdom.
The Angels () = those who are in the First Heaven; the elders = those who are in the Second Heaven; and the four animals = those who are in the Third Heaven. Explained.
One of the elders answered, saying unto me () = influx out of Heaven from the Lord, and consequent perception... By the elders is signified Heaven where the Lord is.
The elders of the daughter of Zion () = the wise and intelligent in the Church; and, abstractedly, wisdom and intelligence.
Priests () = those who teach good; elders, those who teach truth.

By the elders of the people, and the princes thereof () the like things are signified as by the twelve disciples; namely, all of the Church who are in its truths and goods; and, in the abstract sense, the truths and goods of the Church in the whole complex.
The elders of the daughter of Zion = those who were in Divine truths.
